item.title: Mrs. Itu Lustig, 97, OBM
item.description: Mrs. Itu Lustig, one of the last remaining Holocaust survivors living in Crown Heights and the matriarch of a large family, passed away on Thursday, 16 Adar, 5786. Full Story

item.title: JLI Postpones Israel Trip for 500 Participants Amid Iran War
item.description: JLI’s Land & Spirit Israel Experience has been postponed due to the escalating war between Israel and Iran. Full Story

item.title: Rambam In-Depth: Can You Bless Food You Don’t Want to Eat?
item.description: A class by Rabbi Heschel Greenberg on the Rambam’s Mishneh Torah: You can make a Bracha for others unless it's a pleasure-blessing — except when that pleasure is part of a mitzvah like Matzah or Kiddush. Video

item.title: The Project to Translate Torah Or and Likkutei Torah
item.description: A grand plan to publish an elucidated English edition of Torah Or and Likkutei Torah is being undertaken in memory of R’ Gedaliah Shaffer OBM, whose yartzeit is on the 17th of Adar. Full Story

item.title: Rabbi Shais Taub Reveals Methods
item.description: Rabbi Shais Taub is launching a new three-part online course revealing the Torah-based framework he developed from years of answering thousands of complex life questions. Full Story For more than Full Story

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh. Live

item.title: Chinuch in South Africa Fulfills the Rebbe’s Vision for the Country
item.description: Rabbi Zalman Shneur, Director of the Menachem Education Foundation, spent a week touring Jewish schools across South Africa, where he encouraged Mechanchim, Mechanchos and leaders as they began the new school year. Full Story

item.title: Mivtza Purim in Beitar Illit for Security Personnel
item.description: Chabad of Beitar helped the local district police and reserve soldiers staying in the city perform the miztvahs of Purim per the Rebbe’s instructions, including Megillah readings and giving out mishloach manos. Full Story

item.title: Commander Grants Rare Leave for Soldier to Hear the Megillah
item.description: A Jewish soldier received rare leave from the front lines to hear the Megillah in Kyiv. Wearing his uniform, he went straight from the battlefield to the shul. His story became a symbol of Purim in wartime Ukraine. Full Story

item.title: The Friendship Behind a New Book
item.description: Veteran educator and London shliach Rabbi Shmuel Lew received one of the first copies of Clear Vision, written by his best friend, Rabbi Asher Zeilingold of Minnesota. Full Story
